Name: Ore Sweep
Author: cabbgaerabbit
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
Ore Sweep adds a special mining bomb that clears every ore and gem node on the current mine floor in one blast. It is made for fast and clean mining runs, without hurting the player or destroying unrelated tiles and items.By default, the crafting recipe unlocks at Mining Level 8, but you can freely change that requirement through Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b][size=5]## v2.0.0[/size]
[size=4]- Added support for the Volcano Dungeon.
- Increased the magnetism range after detonation to make ore pickup easier.
- Fixed an issue where the Ore Bomb texture could sometimes fail to load.[/size][/b]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Put the [b]OreBomb[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]How to Use[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Reach the required Mining Level to unlock the recipe. Default: Mining Level 8.[/*]
[*]Recipe: 5 Iridium Ore + 2 Gold Ore.[/*]
[*]Craft an Ore Bomb.[/*]
[*]Bring it into the mines.[/*]
[*]Right click it on a safe tile.[/*]
[*]The bomb will clear all ore and gem nodes on the current floor.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Important Notes[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Ore Bomb can only be used inside the mines.[/*]
[*]It deals no damage.[/*]
[*]It does not destroy items.[/*]
[*]It does not break unrelated tiles.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Config[/size][/b]
This mod supports Generic Mod Config Menu. You can change the Mining Level required to unlock the crafting recipe.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Tested in single-player.[/*]
[*]No mod conflicts have been found so far.[/*]
[*]If you find a bug or have suggestions for improvements, please leave a comment.[/*]
[/list]
